header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: and sitting and (lying) on their sides remember Allah.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (فَاذْكُرُوا اللهَ كَذِكْرِكُمْ أَبآءَكُمْ أَوْ أَشَدَّ ذِكْرًا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Remember Allah as you used to remember your forefathers (before Islam), or even more than that.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَاذْكُرْ رَّبَّكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ تَضَرُّعاً وَّخِيفَةً وَّدُونَ الْجَهْرِ مِنَ الْقَوْلِ بِالْغُدُوِّ وَاْلآصَالِ وَلَا تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْغَافِلِينَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) remember your Rabb within yourself with humility and fear, without raising your voice, in the morning and in the evening! Do not be among the heedless.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمَا تَكُونُ فِي شَأْنٍ وَّمَا تَتْلُوا مِنْهُ مِنْ قُرْآنٍ وَّلَا تَعْمَلُونَ مِنْ عَمَلٍ إِلَّا كُنَّا عَلَيْكُمْ شُهُودًا إِذْ تُفِيضُونَ فِيهِ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Whatever matter you are engaged in, whatever you recite of the Qur'an from Him, and whatever deed you do - while you are engaged in it, We are never without watching over you.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالى: (وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلى الْعَزِيزِ الرَّحِيمِ ۞ الَّذِي يَرَاكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ ۞ وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي السّجِدِينَ ۞ إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And rely upon the Almighty (over all things), the Most Merciful (Lord)! He is such that He sees you when you stand (for Salah),
